Name: Will's Scope Creep Demon
Author: Willcraftapple11
Description:
The scope creep demon has been haunting me for a long time now, just as much if not more so as it has haunted my fellow mod authors. So I brought it into the game so we cannot escape it from anywhere!

Killing it gives you a chance to get a totally, 100%, good idea for your wip mods! 
Currently there are 15 different ideas that it can drop. Can you find them all?

Also it has an iridium bat! Go for a home run!
